market.icp: Privacy-conscious meeting participants who need local-first notes
market.buyerPain: A participant reviewing an active note must return to its library card before downloading the note as Markdown.
market.revenueHypothesis: A direct active-note export action shortens the path from captured meeting context to a client-ready local file without adding a sharing provider.

increment.name: active-note-export-cta
acceptanceCriteria: An active note displays an Export note action in its existing action row.
The action calls the existing local Markdown export for the active meeting.
The existing library-card Export MD action remains unchanged.
The new action introduces no CSS, dependency, external sharing API, account, or provider request.
The focused contract, TypeScript, and production build pass locally.
LICENSE, dependency manifests, credentials, providers, billing, and deployment configuration remain unchanged.

delivery.checker: Codex separate local verification; independent checker unavailable in this single-agent slice
delivery.rollback: Revert only the active-note export CTA commit on feat/sidenote-meeting-goal.
delivery.stopCondition: Stop after one verified active-note export increment; do not merge, deploy, submit to an app store, spend, change credentials, or change licensing.
